desc: The Savage AC22 suppressor features 100 percent machined 7075-T6 aluminum and 6AI-4V TI Titanium 1/2x28 direct thread mount. With built in self cleaning carbon cutters, hard coat anodizing and cerakote finish Savage suppressors are built to last. Weighing in at only 3.5oz., this suppressor is rated at 116db with subsonic loads and 125db with super sonic loads.
